parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.business_name, l.status, l.deal_value, l.currency, l.next_follow_up_at,
CASE WHEN l.next_follow_up_at IS NOT NULL AND l.next_follow_up_at < now() THEN 'OVERDUE'
     WHEN l.next_follow_up_at IS NOT NULL AND l.next_follow_up_at::date = now()::date THEN 'DUE_TODAY'
     WHEN l.status = 'PROPOSAL_SENT' THEN 'PROPOSAL_PENDING'
     WHEN l.status = 'QUALIFIED' THEN 'QUALIFIED'
     ELSE 'OTHER' END AS priority_bucket
FROM leads l
WHERE l.status NOT IN ('WON','LOST')
  AND (
    (l.next_follow_up_at IS NOT NULL AND l.next_follow_up_at <= now() + interval '1 day')
    OR l.status IN ('PROPOSAL_SENT','QUALIFIED')
  )
ORDER BY priority_bucket, l.next_follow_up_at NULLS LAST
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) AS total, currency FROM leads WHERE status NOT IN ('WON','LOST') GROUP BY currency
